case_name: Smt Mamatha W/O H S Harish vs Sri H S Harish S/O Late Subbarao H N
facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent were married in 2007. They had a child. Differences arose between them, and the respondent filed a petition for restitution of conjugal rights. The petitioner withdrew from the company of the respondent and filed a petition under Section 13(1)(ia) and (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act. This petition was registered as MC 126/2010.

legal_principles.principle: Courts have to take into consideration the economic soundness of either party, social strata of spouses and their behavioural pattern.
legal_principles.held: Wherever Courts are called upon to consider the plea of transfer in matrimonial matters, Courts have to take into consideration the economic soundness of either of the parties, the social strata of the spouses and the behavioural pattern of their-standard of life antecedent to marriage and subsequent thereon.
cited_cases: NANDA KISHORI VS. S.B. SHIVAPRAKASH, (1993) KARNATAKA 87

outcome.final_order: The case bearing No.126/2010 from the file of the Civil Judge (Sr.Dn.), Tumkur is withdrawn and transferred to the Family Court, Bangalore for trial and disposal in the interest of justice and equity.
